objective: Correct Plan flow, unknown-website lane commitment, YETI-style website routing, review navigation, and visible terminology before pilot result import work continues.
goals: Plan opens with the Live Question before Guided Intake.
Unknown websites cannot auto-commit a lane from notes alone.
YETI routes from website evidence to Dealer Hardgoods / Product SKU language.
Run IDB can navigate to Review without a runtime error.
Plan actions trace lightweight summaries instead of heavy packet payloads.
findings: Plan previously rendered Guided Intake before the Live Question because the Plan branch placed activePanel before guidedStep.
Run IDB could fail before Review because buildAcceptedPacketContext referenced an undefined packet.
Unknown websites could over-commit based on notes when local website evidence was weak.
YETI needs website-owned outdoor gear hardgoods classification, not industrial distribution or food/ingredient language.
Plan click traces were too heavy and could add perceived lag.
fixes: Plan branch now renders guidedStep before activePanel.
Added websiteSignalNeedsReview gate for unknown local website evidence.
Added YETI website primary signal and outdoor hardgoods classifier terms.
Removed undefined packet reference from buildAcceptedPacketContext.
Changed Plan action tracing to compact tracePlanSummary payloads.
